name: Resorttrust, Inc.
summary: Resorttrust, Inc. engages in the hotel and restaurant business in Japan. It operates through three segments: Membership business, Hotel and Restaurant business, and Medical business. The company sells loans to hotel membership purchasers, and the construction of membership-based hotels. It also operates 43 resort hotels and city hotels and 1 in Hawaii; 14 golf courses, 30 medical facilities, and 23 senior residences. In addition, the company is also involved in the operation of hotels and restaurants, hotel cleaning, and member services. insurance agency services, manufacturing and sales of hair accessories, and total beauty services.
